**RESUME HERE (localfold for hv's compact, 2026-09-17 evening): ST0076 WP-03 and issues 0434 and 0436 are landed and closed; WP-06, the Elixir tracer reader, is next, on cc's landed level-3 core.** RECOVER any worktree: a fresh worktree at the bank's base, then `git cat-file -p <ref> | git apply` for each bank in order. Never move a worktree (cargo's target keeps absolute paths) and never share a target dir between worktrees; wt-wp03 is reusable in place on a new base.
LANDED TODAY: WP-03 at 997d760b1 (code, patch-id 4b4ef24b) and a79769b34 (AT-03.1 red then green, the objective, design.md's Elixir cells, wp done). 0434 at bbea0edb9 (patch-id 559fe1da), closed at fc2b648de. 0436 at e2a7df9a7 (patch-id d047f14a, judged green stacked on cc's core, which landed at e302be033 as f7050940, its bank d335d31f plus a type annotation the critic asked for), closed at fb4543031. The pair was rebuilt at 8ec04d9fa, so 0434 and 0436 reach a running daemon at the next rebuild. The gate reads 8/14: WP-07 is open (ic, 5afc4c295: `index.resolution` in the envelope and the `--target` door), and hv drove AC-00.1's three clauses today, with vc writing the evidence.
WP-06, NEXT: vc RULED the build directory. The tracer builds under intent/.cache/resolve/elixir/<env> (Scope.cache plus the env) and never the project's _build; the first run seeds it from the project's _build/<env>/lib, re-pointing every relative symlink at the target it resolves to from the source link's directory, and builds cold otherwise; it re-seeds when mix.lock's hash differs from the one kept beside the seed; later runs are incremental. Measured on a Laksa copy: a shared _build missed a user-compiled edit (0 events); seeded took 10.8 s against 135.7 s cold, rebuilt 0 deps and wrote nothing outside the cache; a cold build writes 17 rebar3 source.dag files under deps/, the named residual. AC-06.1 carries the clause (vc, 06e046a89). THE CORE'S CONTRACT (landed, intentsvcs index/resolved.rs): `trace(&self, scope: &Scope)` with Scope { root, cache, full, indexed }; mix.exs found in `indexed`, else NotApplicable; Missing when elixir is not on PATH; `excludes()` is the closed roster (`operator`); `target_of` prints container.name/arity; `locate` takes the earliest clause when every row is in one file; register in `readers()`; the facade forces full on no stored run, a failed last run or a symbols_version mismatch; the in-memory `Handed` reader in tests/a_resolved_reference_joins_a_written_one.rs is the arm pattern. TARGET SPELLING, agreed with ic for WP-07's `--target`: inspect(module).name/arity (`Map.get/2`, `:ets.lookup/2`, `Kernel.to_string/1`); a local call or local capture targets the enclosing module. BUILD FROM refs/bank/dc/st0076-wp06/ (tracer.exs, measure.sh, seed.sh, shape.awk, both summaries). Arms: hermetic (a trace fixture parsed, target_of and locate, the seed's link re-pointing, NotApplicable, Missing) and one `#[ignore]` toolchain arm under `needs_the_toolchain`, which carries refs/bank/dc/devbin-toolchain (patch-id 5f5682c9) in its landing if it lands before WP-05's Rust arm; AC-06.2's Laksa proof is `intent search --target Map.get/2` after a stored `intent index resolve`. Register before you code: MODULES.md row first. Store writes go through the installed pair only. NO RELEASE, NO PUSH.
